messages.content: Select each passage from your assigned desk that adds a distinct, material fact, reason or qualification to the decision record. Preserve why each position was taken, distinguish positions from Council action, and include all relevant passages. Return only a JSON array of passage IDs, in source order. {"task": "Write a retrospective Council record. State the exact disposition and action, distinguish the voting members from the invited participant, and preserve attributed positions and qualifications. At most 150 words including any decision line.", "assigned_desk": "Peru", "public": [{"id": "vote", "text": "On 27 June 2018, Peru’s draft S/2018/628 was adopted as Resolution 2422 (2018), 14 in favour, none against, with Russia abstaining. Serbia participated without a vote."}, {"id": "action", "text": "Acting under Chapter VII, the Council appointed Serge Brammertz as Prosecutor of the International Residual Mechanism for Criminal Tribunals from 1 July 2018 until 30 June 2020, underlined the need for full state cooperation, and noted the conclusion of its progress review."}, {"id": "limits", "text": "Resolution 2422 did not order temporary medical release for Ratko Mladić or make findings on his treatment. The Council encouraged the Mechanism to consider conditions on early release in appropriate cases, in the separate context of persons convicted by the ICTR."}], "passages": {"1": "Peru said the Mechanism's ability to combat impunity depended on states helping enforce sentences, carry out warrants and answer requests for assistance.", "2": "Peru urged the Council to stay united behind the Mechanism and play its part in securing that cooperation."}}
